question: What's the best off-the-shelf training content library that integrates with Workday or SAP SuccessFactors?
text:
If by “best” you mean best fit for an enterprise that wants a large, ready-made learning library embedded in Workday Learning or SAP SuccessFactors Learning, I’d shortlist Udemy Business, LinkedIn Learning, and Skillsoft Percipio.

My practical shortlist
Library	Workday	SuccessFactors	Particularly strong for
Udemy Business	✅ Deep/approved integration	✅ Deep integration	Broad business + technology skills, rapidly changing topics
LinkedIn Learning	✅ Deep integration	✅ Integration	Business, leadership, productivity, professional skills
Skillsoft Percipio	✅ Supported/CCL integration	✅ Especially strong SAP integration	Enterprise learning, IT, compliance, leadership
Coursera for Business	✅ Supported	✅ Supported via SAP OCN	University-style, professional certificates, technical depth
Go1	✅ Supported	✅ Supported	Aggregating multiple publishers/content sources
OpenSesame	✅ Supported	✅ Supported	Very broad multi-publisher catalog

Workday's current documentation lists Coursera, Go1, Harvard ManageMentor, LinkedIn Learning, OpenSesame, Pluralsight, Skillsoft Percipio and Udemy Business among its external-content providers, while its newer Cloud Connect for Learning platform has a broader provider ecosystem. 
W
Workday Documentation
+1

If you're choosing between the big three

Udemy Business is particularly compelling if your workforce needs technical/digital skills and a very broad, frequently changing catalog. Its integration is unusually comprehensive: Workday can automatically sync courses, learning paths, labs and assessments, with reporting back into Workday. 
W
Workday Marketplace
+1

It also integrates with SuccessFactors: learners can search, discover and launch Udemy content within SuccessFactors, while completion data can flow back for reporting. 
U
Udemy Business
+1

LinkedIn Learning is a strong fit if the emphasis is professional skills, leadership, productivity and business learning. Its Workday integration supports catalog synchronization and completion/activity reporting. 
M
Microsoft Learn
 It also has a SuccessFactors integration, although SAP's authentication transition requires existing customers to make a configuration change before November 20, 2027. 
L
LinkedIn

Skillsoft Percipio is worth serious consideration for a more traditional enterprise L&D environment—particularly if IT, compliance, leadership and structured learning programs are important. SAP actually offers an SAP Content Stream by Skillsoft solution with Business/Technology and additional immersive/practice content editions.

support.sap.com
 Workday also supports Percipio as an external content provider, with skills metadata capable of being incorporated into Workday Skills Cloud.

+1

“Can launch external content from the LMS?”

“Can synchronize the catalog?”

“Can synchronize completions?”

“Can sync learning paths/collections?”

“Can map content to skills?”

“Does it work natively with both Workday and SuccessFactors?”

Udemy currently has particularly explicit capabilities across those dimensions: its Workday integration includes catalog, collections/learning paths, labs, assessments and reporting, while its SuccessFactors integration supports catalog discovery and completion reporting. 
U
Udemy Business
+1

So, if you have both Workday and SuccessFactors in the shortlist and want one content vendor that works well with either ecosystem, I'd put Udemy Business near the top of the RFP. But the right choice depends heavily on whether you're optimizing for technical skills, leadership/business skills, compliance, certifications, or breadth.

If you tell me your employee population (e.g. 5k/20k/100k), main content categories, and whether you're on Workday Learning or SuccessFactors Learning, I can build a vendor-by-vendor comparison including catalog size, integration depth, skills mapping, content quality, pricing model, and likely fit.
